==={{header|FreeBASIC}}===
FB doesn't have Dict natively, but we can implement them via Type
<syntaxhighlight lang="freebasic">Type dict
    m1 As String*1
    m2 As Integer
End Type

Dim mapOf(1 To 3) As dict => {("A", 65), ("B", 66), ("C", 67)}

For i As Integer = 1 To Ubound(mapOf)
    Print mapOf(i).m1
    Print mapOf(i).m2
Next i</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>A
 65
B
 66
C
 67</pre>
